exact_statement: Retain A084-RARE-PHYSICAL-TERMINAL-CURVATURE@1 unchanged for the initial query. Additionally, initially compose h or J with six identical disjoint Boolean cores negative with probability 0<p<=1/16, on every finite uniform cube. After any one actual physical query in block k0 and either actual child, whose negative probability t lies in[0,2p], query any remaining physical coordinate in block j. For the FULL heterogeneous occupied-mask correction C=H(P_occupied)-sum_l q_l h2(4p_l(1-p_l)), Delta C=C_parent-mean C_children satisfies Delta C<=B Inf_query. For j!=k0: B=3/4 for h, 1/8 for J directions1,2,3,5, 3/4 for J direction0, 5/4 for J direction4; the exceptional J pair k0=0,j=4 has B=35/32. For j=k0: B=5/4 for h, 3/4 for J directions1,2,3,5, 7/4 for J0 and 11/4 for J4. All real attainable biases/shifts, zero-pivot and t=0 boundaries, irrelevant coordinates, integrable coefficient zeros and constant children are included. Exact Delta H(F)=q_j Delta H(core_j)+Delta C retains all full terminal entropies, the SAME rate and every old debit. These are signed upper bounds on the added composition correction for at most two physical queries, not inherited-core payment, arbitrary-history closure or FEI.
